description: Task entry type base. Abstract: a task entry is an append-only record attached to a task during execution (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-task-entries). Derived entry kinds narrow `payload` with their own JSON Schema; the engine ships entry_work, entry_observation, entry_issue, entry_note, and entry_measurement, and consuming gears MAY register further kinds. The engine stores entry metadata (id, task, type, creator, tenant, timestamp) in te_task_entries columns and `payload` as compressed JSON (DESIGN cpt-cf-task-engine-design-gts-types).

payload.description: Entry payload. Derived entry kinds narrow this with their own JSON Schema; the engine validates it against the resolved entry type's schema at creation.
